g.text: F4 | unit = independent held-out stream (site-day); 20 streams per policy, one k = 1 fixed from training
(k_source=training_max_offline_min_k) for every policy; same 20 streams across policies, so dots are paired.
Intervals: figure-side percentile bootstrap over streams (1000 draws, seed 20261031); the confirmatory paired
tests are in M/m_summaries.csv, direction baseline minus A (negative = A better): B0_FCFS-A -0.2276
